label: HubSpot
agentGuide: CRM v3. Contacts: GET /crm/v3/objects/contacts?limit=20&properties=firstname,lastname,email,company,lifecyclestage; search: POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts/search {"filterGroups": [{"filters": [{"propertyName": "email", "operator": "EQ", "value": "..."}]}], "properties": ["email", "firstname"]}; create: POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts {"properties": {"email": "...", "firstname": "..."}}; update: PATCH /crm/v3/objects/contacts/<id>. Same shape for companies (/crm/v3/objects/companies, properties name, domain), deals (/crm/v3/objects/deals, properties dealname, amount, dealstage, closedate), tickets, notes (/crm/v3/objects/notes with hs_note_body and hs_timestamp). Link two: PUT /crm/v4/objects/contacts/<id>/associations/default/companies/<id>. Pipelines: GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals. Owners: GET /crm/v3/owners. Properties of an object: GET /crm/v3/properties/contacts. Paging: paging.next.after. The token's scopes bound what works. The token is set by Allkin.
